 Follow Influencer Liam Fitzgerald Dead at 29 After Suffering "Severe Injuries" During Motorcycle Crash
 E! News Sun, November 1, 2026 at 11:55 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Fitness and lifestyle influencer Liam Fitzgerald died on early Oct. 30 after a motorcycle accident, his girlfriend Jamie Lyn Rinaldi shared, noting that he had "suffered severe injuries." He was 29.
